characterInteraction.description: Major Garrett is persistent in his questioning, while Conway becomes more assertive, often deflecting to attacks on Clinton.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The scene captures a real-time political strategy session with potential implications for democratic norms.

mood.description: Tense, anxious, and politically charged. The visuals show both characters engaged with Conway exhibiting varied expressions. The audio features sharp questions and assertive responses, highlighting post-debate controversies.

narrativeProgression.description: Conway emphasizes the importance of the debate for Trump's campaign and downplays any impact on Senate candidates.
Conway defends Trump's debate performance while criticizing Hillary Clinton's record.
Garrett presses Conway about the concern surrounding Trump's refusal to accept election results, hinting at potential problems.
Conway deflects concerns about election results and pivots to attacking Hillary Clinton's views on abortion and her wealth accumulation.

scenes.thematicElements: The interview revolves around political strategy, negative campaigning, and questioning democratic norms. Conway emphasizes Trump's debate benefits, criticizes Clinton, and attempts to justify Trump's refusal to accept election results.
scenes.title: Interview with Kellyanne Conway

youtube_description:
Kellyanne Conway interview with CBS political reporter Major Garrett following the second Presidential Debate in Las Vegas. The Trump campaign manager explains Donald Trump's debate statement that he is unable to say he will accept a Hillary Clinton victory.

Las Vegas, Nevada
October 8, 2016
